<!--
Not every section applies to every PR. Delete what doesn't fit a trivial change;
keep everything relevant on a security-, performance-, or correctness-sensitive one.
-->

Background rationale: [Pull Request Descriptions That Survive Review](https://github.com/atomicdjt/atomicdjt/blob/5c9aacba79fc0c5ebd05a17845a2df781385b1a2/writing/pull-request-descriptions-that-survive-review.md)

## Summary
<!-- One or two sentences: what changed, where. -->

## Root cause
<!-- The actual mechanism, not the symptom, if this is a fix. -->

## Structural solution
<!-- What changed, what deliberately didn't, and why. -->

## Security / behavioral implications
<!-- If applicable: what happens on failure, in both directions. -->

## Validation
<!-- Method, not just "tested." Seed, case count, what the oracle/harness was checked against. -->

## Tests
<!-- What's pinned by name. -->

## Performance impact
<!-- Before/after numbers if relevant, not just "faster." -->

## Risk / blast radius
<!-- Who is affected and how, quantified if possible. -->

## Compatibility
<!-- What existing behavior is explicitly preserved. -->

## Limitations
<!-- What you didn't check, couldn't verify, or know is still weak. -->
